motions.text: That the Council of the City of Guelph now hold a meeting that is closed to the public, pursuant to the Municipal Act, to consider: December 2022 Public Appointments to Advisory Committees of Council, Local Boards and Commissions. motions.text_html:
That the Council of the City of Guelph now hold a meeting that is closed to the public, pursuant to the Municipal Act, to consider:
December 2022 Public Appointments to Advisory Committees of Council, Local Boards and Commissions.        
Section 239(2) (b) of the Municipal Act relating to personal matters about an identifiable individual, including municipal or local board employees.
